preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The length K of the subsequence must be between 1 and the length of the string S.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of lowercase English alphabet characters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subseq) == K for subseq in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output subsequence must have a length of K.
Each output subsequence must be lexicographically smallest.
